name: The Shops at Palm Desert
demographics: The Shops at Palm Desert primarily serves affluent retirees and seasonal residents in the Coachella Valley, along with tourists visiting the Palm Springs area. The trade area attracts upper-middle to high-income households, with a significant proportion of visitors aged 55+ who have substantial discretionary spending power and seek convenience shopping combined with dining experiences. The center also draws younger families and professionals from the growing Palm Desert community who value the mix of department store anchors, specialty retailers, and the extensive restaurant selection in a climate-controlled desert environment.
description: The Shops at Palm Desert is a premier shopping destination in the Coachella Valley featuring major anchors including Macy's, Dick's Sporting Goods, and JCPenney. This vibrant desert hub offers a rich blend of national brands and unique local offerings, plus more than 15 restaurant options for dining, coffee, and snacks.
summary: Located just east of Palm Springs, The Shops at Palm Desert serves as a convenient shopping, dining, and entertainment destination in the Coachella Valley. The center combines national retail brands with local merchants and extensive dining options across a traditional mall format.
